about: Every distributed non-code file, and the licence it ships under (spec §13fx). Read by scripts/make-release.mjs and scripts/try-commercial-content.mjs. A file the release carries that matches no entry here, or an entry whose licence is unknown or non-commercial, fails the release gate. Plant photographs are licensed per photograph in seed/plants.json → photoCredit, which this file points at rather than copies.
